title: Service Tenure and the Payment Extension — Basis Q&A
content:
# Service Tenure and the Payment Extension — Basis Q&A

**Rule.** For a Payment Extension — the single-installment kind of Payment Arrangement — enrolled on a residential agreement under disconnection notice, the tenure relief is 5% when the start date of the Electric Service Agreement under notice lies at least 180 whole calendar months before enrollment, 2% when it lies at least 60 but fewer than 180 whole calendar months before, and zero when it is more recent.

## Questions the rule answers

**Whose start date is read?** The start date of the Electric Service Agreement under disconnection notice, not of any other agreement of the customer.

**How are months counted?** In whole calendar months between the start date and the enrollment date.

**What applies at exactly 60 whole months?** 2%.

**What applies at 179 whole months?** 2%.

**What applies at exactly 180 whole months?** 5%.

**What applies at 59 whole months?** Zero.

| Whole calendar months since the start date | 59 | 60 | 179 | 180 | 240 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Tenure relief | 0 | 2% | 2% | 5% | 5% |
